key_findings: Use 3-tier evaluation (programmatic -> LLM sample -> human review), NOT 7 judges on every output
Pointwise scoring with G-Eval pattern is the production standard for LLM-as-judge
Self-preference bias: use different model family as judge than generator
Self-improvement loops require hard floors, human review of prompt changes, and diversity monitoring
DSPy prompt optimization only after 100+ evaluated outputs — manual tuning first
Langfuse recommended for observability (open-source, self-hosted, nested traces)
Graduated autonomy: Phase 1 -> 2 -> 3 based on quantitative criteria, not vibes
Cost reduction: $900/month (original plan) -> $30-60/month (recommended) with 80% quality signal
next_phase_input: Write spec for Holus evaluation infrastructure based on docs/research/001-agent-evaluation-observability.md
